bandReport.notes: B4 COMPLETE - Q94-120 across p18-p22, 27 questions. Per-page ranges: p18 = printed p37, Q94-98; p19 = p39, Q99-101 (only THREE questions - two Match Lists, one of them map-based, plus a long statement question); p20 = p41, Q102-105; p21 = p43, Q106-112 (seven, the densest page of the band); p22 = p45, Q113-120. Q94 is complete and starts fresh - B3 ended cleanly at Q93 on p17. THE PAPER ENDS AT Q120, confirmed FOUR independent ways: (1) the contiguous run 1-120 closes with no gap, B3 having delivered Q65-93 and B4 Q94-120; (2) Q120's option (d) 'Methane' completes and BOTH columns of p22 end in clean whitespace with no continuation; (3) p22 is the last render and the source PDF has exactly 23 pages, indices 0-22, measured with PyMuPDF; (4) p22's printed page number is 45, which is 2x22+1, the last odd number in the odd-only printed sequence this corpus uses. NOTE THAT p22 DOES PRINT '[ P.T.O.' at its foot even though it is the final page, so on this booklet P.T.O. is spurious and proves nothing either way - exactly as warned. TWO COLUMN-BREAKS: on p19 Q100's stem and three statements sit at the BOTTOM of the left column while its 'Select the correct answer' line and all four code rows are printed at the TOP of the right column above Q101 (it is a three-statement code, which confirms the ownership); on p20 Q104's two Lists end the left column while its 'Code :' line and all four code rows are printed at the TOP of the right column above Q105. CODE-ORDER: Q96 and Q103 each have four statements and NO all-four row, and both mix 'only' inconsistently - Q96's (b) '2 and 3' carries no 'only' while its (d) '2 and 4 only' does, and Q103's (a) and (d) are both three-item rows with no 'only' on either. THREE Match Lists (Q99, Q101, Q104), and every one of them has its (a)/(b) pair and its (c)/(d) pair differing ONLY in the B/C positions, so the four rows are two near-identical pairs in each case; Q99 and Q101 additionally sit on the SAME page. Every row was read off the page at 9-14x independently and no question's code was inferred from another's. Q101 is FIGURE-DEPENDENT: its List-II is four circled numerals printed on an outline map of NE India with no text, so the map's geometry and adjacencies are described in the stem without naming which State each numeral marks. PAGE DEFECT: a stray ink blot sits in the whitespace above option (d)'s 'C' column header in Q99's code block on p19; verified at 14x, it obscures no digit. LAYOUT: Q109 on p21 prints its four options as a TWO-COLUMN grid, (a) beside (b) and (c) beside (d), each label carrying its own text so the pairing is unambiguous.
